newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AFRIBRAND BUYS SNACK FIRM FOR 20.4 MLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: AFRIBRAND BUYS SNACK FIRM FOR 20.4 MLN RAND.

text.p: Recently listed confectionary to snacks group Afribrand Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had acquired snack food manufacturer DowMont CC for 20.42 million rand.

The company said in a statement that the acquisition, which follows a cautionary on August 6, was effective from June 1 1997 and was expected to take its earnings for the year to May 31, 1998 to 11.4 cents a share.
DowMont is a KwaZulu-Natal-based manufacturer of snack foods under the DowMont Naks and DowMont Snaks labels.
The deal would be settled by an issue of roughly 8.42 million shares of 200 cents each and 1.43 million new shares at 250 cents each to DowMont.
DowMont had renounced the 1.43 million shares in favour of selected institutions, the company said.

The new shares would rank equally with shares already on issue and an application would be made to the Johannesburg Stock Exchange for a listing of the 9.85 million shares to be issued in terms of the acquisition.
Afribrand added that it was in further negotiations which could have an effect on its share price.
Shareholders were advised to continue exercising caution in their share dealings until further notice.
